data.name: Ubaniel
data.long_meaning: Ubaniel is a Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew words 'Elohi' (God) and 'Yibhun' (help). It means 'God is my helper'. In the Bible, this name is associated with the angel who led the Israelites to victory over the Midianites (Judges 7:9). Ubaniel is also mentioned in the Old Testament as a descendant of Judah and a father of Perez (Genesis 38:27).
data.spiritual_meaning: Ubaniel is a name that embodies faith and trust in God's help and guidance.
data.numerology_meaning: A loving and nurturing soul, Ubaniel is a name for a boy who will grow up to be caring and supportive. He will be compassionate and understanding, with a strong desire to help others.

in_hebrew.name: אובניאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אובניאל הוא שם שמורכב משתי מילים: 'אוב' שפירושו 'אב' או 'אוהב', ו'ניאל' שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא הבוחן שלי'. השם אובניאל מתאר אדם שמאוהב באלוהים ומונחה על ידו.

in_greek.name: Ουβανιήλ
in_greek.meaning: Ουβανιήλ - ο Θεός είναι ο δοκιμαστής μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ουβανιήλ προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'οὐβ' που σημαίνει 'πατήρ' ή 'αγαπητός' και 'νιήλ' που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο δοκιμαστής μου'. Το Ουβανιήλ εκφράζει μια σχέση αγάπης και εμπιστοσύνης προς τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Ubaniel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ubaniel derivatur ex verbis 'Uban' quod significat 'amator' vel 'pater', et 'iel' quod significat 'Deus est iudex meus'. Ubaniel personam designat quae Deum amat et ab eo gubernatur.
